label: owns organization or asset
definition: Person or organization X owns or has owned organization, business, team or asset Y, wholly or partly.
scope_notes: Owner, co-owner, parent, subsidiary and explicit acquisition/ownership support qualify, including historical ownership and stated shares. Management, leadership, publication/distribution alone, merger proposals without completion, and location are distinct.

facts.reason: Marge Schott is directly owner of the Cincinnati Reds. Suspension from operations or partner-position disputes do not negate historical ownership.
Walt Disney Company owns ABC and is explicitly its parent and owner.
Robert S. Mueller III takes office as F.B.I. director; holding a public leadership office is not ownership of the agency.
Rupert Murdoch explicitly owns Fox and is described as its owner, beyond chairman-of-parent evidence.
Danny Meyer is owner and co-owner of Union Square Cafe and explicitly owns it.
